initial_prompt: Write a short poem about the feeling of rain on a hot summer day.

messages.content: Write a short poem about the feeling of rain on a hot summer day.

The air hung heavy, thick and still,
The pavement baked against its will.
Then clouds rolled in to mask the gray,
And wash the fevered heat away.

A hiss of steam, the scent of stone,
A coolness sinks into the bone.
The sky exhales its silver strain,
The sweet relief of summer rain.
